title: Environmental DNA reveals organic contamination of non-perennial river reaches, contrary to traditional biomonitoring methods
description: The present study aimed at evaluating the impact of organic contamination in the Albarine river on macro-invertebrates through morphotaxonomy, bulk and eDNA (from watersamples) metabarcoding.
